info.description:
Backend API for account/children signup and the país/estado catalog.
See contracts/post-accounts.md and contracts/get-catalog.md under
specs/001-registro-cuenta-usuario/ for the source-of-truth prose contracts.
info.title: PediTrack API

post.description:
Creates a padre/tutor account, optionally with one or more children in the
same request, for the tutor who already completed sign-up with Clerk (correo+
contraseña or Google) — the caller's verified Clerk session is required, and its
email is what gets stored, never a client-supplied one (specs/008-autenticacion-cuenta).
A brand-new account always starts on the free plan, which allows at most 1 child
(FR-007) — enforced server-side regardless of what the client already validated.
Idempotent: if the session already has an account linked, returns it with 200
instead of creating a duplicate; an account created before authentication existed
with the same verified email is linked and returned with 200 too.

200.description: The session already had an account linked

400.description: Missing/invalid field, e.g. a future birth date

403.description: The session's email address is not verified

422.description: Free plan already has 1 child; upgrade required

get.description:
Resolves the account linked to the caller's verified Clerk session — the
replacement for a client-supplied accountId (specs/008-autenticacion-cuenta). An
account created before authentication existed, with the session's own verified
email, is linked on this first access. A 404 is the expected state right after a
brand-new Clerk sign-up, before POST /accounts has run.
get.summary: Get the authenticated tutor's own account

404.description: No account is linked to this session yet

get.description:
Retrieves an account (tutor + children) by id (FR-001). Requires a Clerk session
that owns this account (specs/008-autenticacion-cuenta): 403 for any other.
get.summary: Get an account and its children

Adds a single child to an account already created, from the home page's

Lists the routines the person made for themselves — active first, then paused and ended — each with only the

family they belong to; the server decides): otherwise 422 "freemium_consultation_limit_exceeded" with reason
"supplements"; with 10 active personal routines, 422 "routine_limit_exceeded".

post.description:
Registers a consultation with its prescription photo, medications, notes and marked symptoms
(FR-003, FR-004). At least one medication is required (FR-015), and each one needs
its startTime ("HH:MM"): all of its doses are generated at once from it (research.md).
Every symptomCodes entry must be an active catalog symptom, or 400 with details[].message "symptom_not_available" (specs/012).
On the free plan, a consultation is refused with 422 "freemium_consultation_limit_exceeded" while any child of the account
still has an active treatment (reason "active_treatment") and when recordOnly is true (reason "record_only"); paid accounts have neither limit (specs/030).

post.description:
The paid plan's history: lists the child's consultations that meet every criterion given (text, date range,
doctor, medication, symptoms, kind), most recent first, in the same shape as the plain list. It only finds what
was registered. It is a POST so the typed text is not part of the address. A free account always gets 422
"freemium_consultation_limit_exceeded" with reason "history_search" and no consultations.
post.summary: Search and filter a child's consultations

Saves the appointment exactly as written; nothing else of the consultation changes. Paid plan only (422 reason

but never fires. A consultation has at most one scheduled appointment (409).

patch.description:
Sets a dose's taken status. No validation of scheduled date or treatment
status — a dose can be marked/unmarked at any time (FR-011, FR-016).
Marking is first-come: a dose already marked answers 200 as it is, with who marked it (takenBy, specs/032).
Unmarking is for who marked it or for someone who can do everything (the owner or a Tutor); anyone else gets 403.
patch.summary: Mark or unmark a dose as taken

post.description:
Records when the parent ended the treatment (irreversible). No dose is deleted: the ones whose
time hadn't come turn "canceled" and stop being reminded. Idempotent: ending it again returns the
same result (specs/016).

post.description:
Only because the parent decided so (their doctor told them to): adds `doses` doses after the last one, one
frequency apart, records who decided and what was proposed vs confirmed, and marks the unregistered doses as
covered so they are never proposed twice. Nothing that exists changes. Not idempotent on purpose: a second
attempt for the same doses gets nothing_to_extend (specs/020).

get.description:
The session's role in its family (owner for the owner account and for someone who shares nothing), the
family's plan, whether the session is read-only because that plan is no longer paid, the people, and — to
who can do everything — the invitations waiting and the places taken (specs/032-compartir-con-familia).

post.description:
Invites an e-mail as a Tutor or a Caregiver. Only who can do everything (the owner or a Tutor) and only when the
owner is on the paid plan. The invitation expires in 7 days; the token of its link is returned here, once.
Only the account whose verified e-mail is the invited one can accept it.

gets their membership back.

Only who can do everything in the family (the owner or a Tutor of a paid family). A Tutor can't be removed by
anybody — not even by the owner —; the only way to cut a Tutor's access is for the owner to stop paying.
What the person registered stays. Takes effect at once.

get.description:
For the team that runs the service, not for parents: needs the operation key (`Authorization: Bearer
<OPS_API_KEY>`), and the route does not exist when the server has none. A wrong or missing key gets the
same 404 as an unknown route. Filters by period (default: the last 7 days), endpoint (exact or prefix such as
`job:`), status and account; paged by cursor (100 by default, at most 500).
get.summary: List the registered errors, newest first

get.description:
Groups by endpoint, status and message with how often each happened and when first and last; the most
frequent first (the most recent breaks a tie), up to 100 groups. Same key and filters as the list.
get.summary: Summarize the registered errors of a period

endedAt.description: EndedAt is when the parent ended the treatment early (specs/016); null while it runs.

extendableDoses.description:
ExtendableDoses is how many unregistered doses haven't been covered by an extension yet (specs/020): the number the
app proposes adding; the button "Recorrer tratamiento" shows only when it is above 0. 0 once the treatment ended.

extensions.description: Extensions are the parent's decisions to add doses to the end, oldest first.

kind.description:
Kind is "medication" or "supplement" (specs/033). A supplement dose has routineId and an empty consultationId, its
routine's name is in medicationName, and it is marked with PATCH /routines/{routineId}/doses/{doseId}.

message.example: The free plan includes one active treatment at a time

reason.description:
Reason is "active_treatment" (another treatment is still running), "record_only" (saving only as a record) or
"history_search" (searching and filtering the history, specs/031).

doctor.description: Doctor is a doctor's name exactly as registered (see history-options).

from.description: From and To bound the consultation date, both ends included ("YYYY-MM-DD"); To must not be before From.

kind.description: Kind narrows to "treatment" (with a schedule) or "record" (saved only as a record); "all" or empty doesn't filter.

medication.description: Medication is a medication's name exactly as registered (see history-options).

q.description: Q matches the doctor, the notes or the name of any medication, ignoring case and accents, as a part of the text (up to 100 characters).

symptomCodes.description: SymptomCodes are catalog codes; the consultation must have all of them (retired ones included).

status.description: Status is derived by the server with its own clock: pending, due, taken or unregistered ("sin registrar").

noticeSeen.description: NoticeSeen: the person already pressed «Entendido» on the section's first-time notice (on any device).

paidPlan.description: PaidPlan: their own plan is paid or they belong to a family whose owner's is (the server decides).

reason.description: Reason is "supplements" (creating, editing and resuming routines are the paid plan's).

kind.description: Kind: "supplement" (default) or "activity"; an edit keeps the routine's own kind.

weekdays.description: Weekdays: 0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday; an activity with none happens every day.

canEdit.description: CanEdit: the session can do everything AND the owner's plan is paid (so the app doesn't offer a button that would answer 422/403).

createdBy.description: CreatedBy is the first name of who created it (never an e-mail).

kind.description: Kind: a supplement is taken at fixed hours (times); an activity is done every so often from windowStart to windowEnd.

myReminders.description: MyReminders: the session has not turned this routine's reminders off («Tus avisos»); each person decides for themselves.

nextDose.description: NextDose: the next dose ahead of the window, only for an active routine with no dose in it.

weekdays.description: Weekdays: 0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday; an activity with none happens every day.

everything may).

disclaimerVersion.description:
DisclaimerVersion is the version of the "Antes de empezar" notice the client must show, and
DisclaimerAccepted whether this account already acknowledged it (specs/010-registro-aceptacion-aviso).

family.description:
Family is present only when the session is an invited person of another account's family; its children are then
in Children, after the account's own.

reminderDetail.description:
ReminderDetail is what the dose reminders show, "detailed" or "generic"; null until the tutor
chooses on the first activation (specs/011-recordatorios-push).

accountId.description:
AccountID is the account the child belongs to (the family's owner), Role the session's role over this child
("owner" for its own children), Plan the plan of that family and ReadOnly whether the session can only see and mark
(specs/032-compartir-con-familia).

notes.example: Comió mariscos el domingo; la fiebre empezó el lunes

recordOnly.description:
RecordOnly saves the consultation only as a record (specs/024): optional, false by default. When true the
medications' "startTime" is not required and is discarded, so no doses (and no reminders) exist.

symptomCodes.description: SymptomCodes are catalog codes (GET /catalog/symptoms); optional, duplicates ignored.

utcOffsetMinutes.description:
UTCOffsetMinutes is the parent's UTC offset, so "startTime" is read in
their own time zone. Optional: 0 (default) means UTC.
